name: two_half_hitches
title: Two half hitches
also: double half hitch round the standing part
about: Ties a rope to a ring, a rail or a post: one turn round it, then two half hitches round the rope's own standing part, both made the same way, so that they form a clove hitch on the standing part. Shown loose and flat.

steps.caption: The rod, rail or ring the rope is tied to.
Bring the end up over the rod in front and down behind it.
First half hitch: take the end across over the standing part, back under it, and down over its own part.
Second half hitch, below the first and made the same way: over the standing part, back under it, and out over its own part. Push the two hitches together and up to the rod.
